delivery.outcome: Keep workspace lifecycle and overlap test fixtures, HOME and XDG in canonical owner cache while preserving negative layout and protected snapshot checks.
nonGoals: No production allocator behavior or package projection changes
No runtime deployment, releasegrant, tag/Release or adopter effect
No legacy metadata movement or foreign worktree mutation

architecture.decision: The integration suite owns a non-symlink canonical repository cache and one private fixture tree. Prohibited system-temp paths are classified through the existing pure lexical Worktrees API without creating those paths; actual registered fixture worktrees stay in the owner cache and retain negative lifecycle checks. The overlap suite also owns its private HOME/XDG and Python scratch so installation regressions cannot depend on or mutate the actual user home.
architecture.rollback: Revert reviewed test-only change through protected source publication; preserve runtime and release gates.

validation.evidence: Native lifecycle suite with own cache; unchanged negative finding counts, actual registered lifecycle recovery, and explicit pure lexical /tmp classification. Native overlap and snapshot contribution/local-only identity tests under fixture-only HOME/XDG; original11+18 Python suites also verified with owner-primary cache.

commands: Independent exact-head required hosted CI and Validator
validation.evidence: Two implementation test files in one component; no production API/contract changes; actual independent required hosted CI/App review and merge.
